data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 以跨任务共享的代码库为可复用工件，编码代理闭环开发并逐轮扩展该库，能力跨任务累积，属方法类自改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: coding agents develop the library in a closed loop, and each change is explicit and controllable
scope_support.object_quote: different tasks share one library without a VLM or VLA in the loop
scope_support.persistence_quote: new tasks reuse, inherit, or extend the shared library, so capabilities can accumulate over tasks
